# 9.3.0

## Highlights

9.3.0 is a **schema-completeness and test-platform** release. `WopiCheckFileInfo` now carries every CheckFileInfo property the Cloud Storage Partner Program profile allows: 39 new properties bring it to **131**, typed from the same schema the pinned WOPI validator ships, with the CSPP+-only properties deliberately left out. `WopiActionEnum` gained the six action names that appear in the OO2019 / OOS2016 discovery documents but had no member to bind to — `Open`, `EmbedEdit`, `EmbedPreview`, `EmbedConfigurator`, `FormPreview` and `PreloadUnifiedApp` — appended so the ordinals of existing members are unchanged.

Underneath, the test suite moved to **xunit.v3 4.0.0 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform**. xunit.v3 4.x drops MTP v1, and MTP v2 refuses to run through the VSTest target on the .NET 10 SDK, so this had to be a platform migration rather than a version bump: `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk`, `xunit.runner.visualstudio`, `JunitXml.TestLogger` and both coverlet packages are gone, `Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage` emits the cobertura reports, and `.runsettings` — which MTP does not read at all — is replaced by an xUnit trait filter in `Directory.Build.props`. A 26-finding test-quality audit landed on top of it, and the CI lanes now finish with zero warning and zero error annotations.

⚠️ **Requires .NET 10** (unchanged since 9.0). **No public-API breaking changes** — every change to the shipped packages is additive, so consuming code recompiles untouched. Contributors do need to adjust how they invoke tests: `dotnet test` runs under MTP now, where `--project <path-to-csproj>` replaces a directory argument and `--filter-method` replaces `--filter`. See the Contributor notes below.

## ✨ New

- **The remaining CSPP CheckFileInfo properties** ([#651](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/651)) — 39 properties added to `WopiCheckFileInfo`, taking it from 92 to 131: the `Supports*` capability flags (`SupportsPolicies`, `SupportsReviewing`, `SupportsCheckUserAccess`, `SupportsGetActivities`, …), the policy/compliance surface (`AppliedPolicyId`, `ComplianceDomainPrefix`, `CopyPasteRestrictions`, `SafeLinksStatus`, `ProtectedFile`), the embedding surface (`EmbeddingPageOrigin`, `EmbeddingPageSessionInfo`, `HostDivSyndicationViewUrl`), workflow (`WorkflowType`, `WorkflowUrl`) and the five remaining PostMessage flags. `AadUserObjectId` and `DirectInvokeDavUrl` follow the existing `Sha256` pattern — analyzer-friendly identifier, wire name pinned via `JsonPropertyName` — so the JSON stays `AADUserObjectId` / `DirectInvokeDAVUrl`.
- **Six discovery actions** ([#651](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/651)) — `WopiActionEnum` could not express six action names present in the discovery documents this repo uses as test fixtures. They are appended rather than inserted, so no existing member's ordinal moves.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Coverage reporting restored end-to-end** ([#647](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/647), [#659](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/659), [#660](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/660), [#681](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/681), [#682](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/682)) — the Codecov CLI auto-detects reports only by name, and does not expand globs passed through the action's `files:` input, so MTP's `<guid>.cobertura.xml` output made every upload find zero reports: `codecov/patch` and `codecov/project` were never posted and PRs hung on required checks. Qlty was failing for a different reason — a test project with no covered code emits an empty `<packages />`, which its parser rejects outright (`missing field 'package'`), aborting the whole upload behind a green check. Reports are now normalized by a shared composite action (prune-then-rename, used by all three workflows), the Codecov CLI's language plugins are turned off since cobertura reaches it directly, and the CI upload fails the job on error so a silent regression is not possible again. The release lane, which had the same holes, is fixed too — but deliberately keeps its upload non-fatal, since a Codecov outage must not block publishing.
- **Collabora E2E save test on CODE 26.04** ([#679](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/679)) — the freshly-pulled CODE 26.04 stopped honouring the notebookbar view-mode toggle the test clicked, and the failure was swallowed by design: the document stayed read-only, the keystrokes went nowhere, and a no-op save still rewrote the file, so the assertions passed on an edit that never happened. Each precondition is now proved rather than assumed — edit mode via the affordances Collabora wires for documents that start read-only, a hard `Doc_ModifiedStatus` dirty gate, and the typed marker read back out of `word/document.xml`.

## 🧹 Refactors & internals

- **xunit.v3 4.0.0 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform** ([#654](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/654)) — the VSTest hosting stack is retired: `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` and `xunit.runner.visualstudio` exist only to host VSTest and xunit.v3 4.x embeds its own MTP entry point; `coverlet.msbuild`/`coverlet.collector` cannot survive the move (an MSBuild target and a VSTest datacollector respectively) and are replaced by `Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage`; `JunitXml.TestLogger` gives way to xUnit's own `--report-xunit-junit`. `global.json` declares `"test": { "runner": "Microsoft.Testing.Platform" }`. The `Category=E2E` exclusion moves from `.runsettings` to `TestingPlatformCommandLineArguments` in `Directory.Build.props`; `WopiHost.E2ETests`, whose entire suite carries the trait, opts out of MTP's "filter matched no tests" error in its own csproj so the other projects keep failing loudly if their tests ever vanish.
- **Test-quality audit — all 26 findings** ([#678](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/678), closes [#677](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/issues/677)) — the proof validator's negative tests now drive the signed timestamp from a fixed clock (wall-clock had tripped the staleness window and over-determined every rejection) and pin each branch via the `ProofValidationFailures` reason tag; that pinning immediately exposed a test whose comment claimed the `CryptographicException` arm while it actually hit the outer catch on Linux. Status-only integration oracles now probe the side effect they promise — `PutFile` re-reads content, `DeleteContainer` probes for 404, suggested-mode child creation asserts the sanitised name, ancestry asserts the JSON shape — and the concurrency stress tests assert forward/reverse map agreement unconditionally instead of behind an `if`.

## 🔧 Maintenance, CI & dependencies

- **Dependabot rebase queue** ([#661](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/661), [#664](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/664), [#674](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/674)) — Dependabot only rebases on conflict, so under required-up-to-date branch protection every merge stranded the remaining green PRs. The queue now asks the oldest stale auto-merging PR to rebase, one per run, so it drains serially. Two follow-ups made it actually work: auto-merge pushes are attributed to `github-actions[bot]` and emit no workflow events, so the queue chains off the CI workflow completing rather than the push; and `@dependabot rebase` is a permanent no-op for a PR whose recorded base commit already matches the branch tip, so the queue watches the head SHA and escalates to the unconditional `@dependabot recreate`.
- **Audit skill covers test quality** ([#678](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/678)) — the standing `codebase-audit` skill gains a test-smell / antipattern dimension (weak oracles, sleeps, assertion-free and compiler-only tests) distilled from the `dotnet/skills` `dotnet-test` criteria, so repeat audits sweep the suite as well as the source.
- **Aspire CLI bundle opt-out** ([#679](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/679)) — the AppHost is driven by `dotnet run` (VS F5, the E2E fixtures, CI) and uses no feature needing the bundled Aspire CLI, so it sets `AspireUseCliBundle=false` and suppresses the ASPIRE010 nudge at the source rather than carrying the download weight in every build lane.
- **Aspire pins can no longer drift** ([#690](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/690)) — the AppHost's `Aspire.AppHost.Sdk` pin lives on an `<Sdk>` element, which Dependabot's nuget ecosystem does not scan, so it fell a patch behind the `Aspire.Hosting.*` packages with no build or CI symptom. The AppHost now fails its build when the two disagree, and Renovate owns both halves in one grouped PR so they move together.
- **Dev-loop editors & emulators**: collabora/code `26.04.3.1.1 → 26.04.3.2.1` ([#685](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/685)); mock-oauth2-server `5.0.2 → 6.0.2` with the 6.0.0 Renovate exclusion retired now that upstream's NumericDate serialization is fixed ([#648](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/648), [#665](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/665)).
- **Dependency bumps** (consolidated): xunit.v3 / .assert / .extensibility.core `3.2.2 → 4.0.0` and `Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage 18.10.0` added ([#654](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/pull/654)); Aspire.Hosting.\* and Aspire.AppHost.Sdk `13.4.6 → 13.5.3`, StackExchange.Redis `3.1.13 → 3.1.31`, Microsoft.AspNetCore.\* / Microsoft.Extensions.\* (runtime) `10.0.10 → 10.0.11`, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience / ServiceDiscovery `10.8.0 → 10.9.0`, OpenTelemetry.\* `1.17.0 → 1.18.0`, Scalar.AspNetCore `2.16.17 → 2.17.1`, Testcontainers / .Azurite / .Redis `4.13.0 → 4.14.0`, Microsoft.Playwright `1.61.0 → 1.62.0`, Azure.Storage.Blobs `12.29.1 → 12.29.2`, Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub `10.0.301 → 10.0.400`; `github/codeql-action 4.37.6 → 4.37.9`, `anthropics/claude-code-action 1.0.186 → 1.0.210`, and `codecov/test-results-action` replaced by `codecov/codecov-action@v7` with `report_type: test_results` now that the former is deprecated.

## Contributor notes

No consumer action is required for this release. Anyone building or testing the repo should know that `dotnet test` now runs on Microsoft.Testing.Platform:

```diff
  # A single project — MTP needs the .csproj path, not the directory
- dotnet test test/WopiHost.Core.Tests
+ dotnet test --project test/WopiHost.Core.Tests/WopiHost.Core.Tests.csproj

  # A single test — MTP uses xUnit's own filter arguments
- dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~TestMethodName"
+ dotnet test --project test/WopiHost.Core.Tests/WopiHost.Core.Tests.csproj --filter-method "*TestMethodName*"
```

The repo-root `.runsettings` is deleted — MTP does not read it. The `Category=E2E` exclusion now lives in `TestingPlatformCommandLineArguments` in `Directory.Build.props`, which appends to every test project's MTP command line. To run an E2E suite, clear that property on the command line (making it a global MSBuild property) and select the lane with its `Client` trait:

```diff
- dotnet test test/WopiHost.E2ETests            # .runsettings ANDed Category!=E2E, so no CLI override was possible
+ dotnet test --project test/WopiHost.E2ETests/WopiHost.E2ETests.csproj -p:TestingPlatformCommandLineArguments= --filter-trait "Client=Collabora"
```

Clearing the property also overrides the csproj's `--ignore-exit-code 8` append, so a `Client` filter matching nothing now fails loudly instead of passing vacuously.

See [test/WopiHost.E2ETests/README.md](https://github.com/petrsvihlik/WopiHost/blob/master/test/WopiHost.E2ETests/README.md) for the full local-run command.
